recipes.title: Pasta al Pomodoro
recipes.description: Pasta tossed with fresh tomato sauce, garlic and basil.
steps: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in oil, add tomato sauce and simmer briefly.
Toss pasta with sauce and basil and serve.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
recipes.description: Pasta with a medley of fresh vegetables and olive oil or light cream.
steps: Cook pasta and set aside.
Sauté vegetables in oil until tender, toss with pasta and Parmesan and serve.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Cold pasta salad tossed with pesto, cherry tomatoes and peas.
ingredients: 300 g short pasta cooked and cooled
steps: Toss pasta with pesto, tomatoes, peas and oil.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Classic pizza topped with tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil.
steps: Preheat oven as directed.
Top base with sauce, mozzarella and basil, drizzle oil and bake until golden.

recipes.title: Cheesy Baked Ziti
recipes.description: Baked pasta layered with ricotta and melted mozzarella.
steps: Mix pasta with marinara and ricotta, top with mozzarella and bake until bubbly.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.description: Baked breaded eggplant with marinara and melted cheese.
ingredients: Olive oil for frying or brushing
steps: Coat eggplant in egg and breadcrumbs and bake or fry until golden.
Layer with marinara and cheese and bake until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy Arborio rice cooked with mushrooms and stock until silky.
steps: Sauté onion and mushrooms, add rice and gradually add stock stirring until creamy.
Finish with butter and Parmesan and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Gnocchi with Butter
recipes.description: Soft gnocchi tossed in brown butter and sage for an elegant dish.
steps: Cook gnocchi until they float, drain.
Brown butter in a pan, add sage, toss gnocchi in butter and finish with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Pancetta Pasta
recipes.description: Pasta with crispy pancetta, garlic and creamy sauce.
steps: Cook pancetta until crisp, add garlic, cream and toss with pasta and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Pesto Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Pasta tossed with tender chicken and bright basil pesto.
steps: Cook pasta, toss with pesto, chicken and peas, loosen with pasta water if needed.

recipes.title: Cheesy Spinach Pasta
recipes.description: Creamy pasta with wilted spinach and melted cheese.
steps: Cook pasta, wilt spinach in butter, add cream, combine with pasta and cheese.

recipes.title: Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Deconstructed burrito served over rice with beans, meat and salsa.
steps: Assemble rice, beans, meat, corn and avocado in bowls and top with salsa.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Burrito
recipes.description: Quick burritos with seasoned beef, rice and beans rolled in tortillas.
steps: Cook beef with seasoning, then assemble tortillas with rice, beans, beef and cheese; fold and serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Quesadilla
recipes.description: Toasted tortillas filled with melted cheese and optional beans or veggies.
steps: Place cheese on half a tortilla, add extras, fold and toast in a dry skillet until golden.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fried Rice
recipes.description: Sweet-savory fried rice with pineapple and vegetables, optionally egg.
steps: Sauté vegetables, add rice and pineapple, stir in soy sauce and fry until heated; add scrambled egg if using.

recipes.title: Vegetable Paella
recipes.description: Saffron-scented rice with assorted vegetables and a slightly smoky flavor.
steps: Sauté onion and pepper, add rice and paprika, pour in broth and simmer without stirring until rice is cooked.

recipes.title: Vegetable Paella (Quick)
recipes.description: A quick version of paella using frozen vegetables and quick-cook rice.
steps: Sauté vegetables in oil, add rice and broth and paprika and simmer until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Tofu Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crispy tofu with mixed vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: Pan-fry tofu until golden, set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add tofu and sauce and serve over rice.
